assumptions: Repository provisional boundary is used for intake visualization and topology checks only; it is not an official redline or precise-area basis.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: replacement or revision of the submitted site-boundary feature

assumptions: Submitted building polygons are conceptual evidence objects, not a cleared existing-building survey.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: replacement or revision of any submitted building polygon

assumptions: Both numerator and denominator use submitted provisional geometry.
green_ratio.numerator_definition: area of submitted green-space polygons in EPSG:4548
green_ratio.denominator_definition: area of submitted site-boundary polygon in EPSG:4548

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: revision of green-space or site-boundary geometry

assumptions: Both numerator and denominator use submitted provisional geometry.
public_space_ratio.numerator_definition: area of submitted public-space polygons in EPSG:4548
public_space_ratio.denominator_definition: area of submitted site-boundary polygon in EPSG:4548

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: revision of public-space or site-boundary geometry

assumptions: No cleared total-floor-area inventory or official site boundary is available.
floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and official site boundary are not present in the public site package.
floor_area_ratio.numerator_definition: cleared total floor area within the official calculation boundary
floor_area_ratio.denominator_definition: official site area under the applicable planning rule
floor_area_ratio.recalculation_trigger: receipt of cleared official controls, boundary, and floor-area inventory

assumptions: The count represents the three required conceptual key-area objects, not cleared official polygons.

calculation_metadata.recalculation_trigger: replacement of the submitted key-area feature collection

assumptions: Requires voluntary task testing with accessible participation and professional review.
independent_task_completion_rate.reason: No cleared field baseline or real participant study is available.
independent_task_completion_rate.numerator_definition: valid tasks completed from fixed start to fixed end without unplanned personal assistance, with protocol-defined reasonable accommodation allowed
independent_task_completion_rate.denominator_definition: all valid observed tasks; withdrawals and technical failures are reported separately and never silently removed
independent_task_completion_rate.exclusions: only protocol-defined invalid observations, with count and reason disclosed
independent_task_completion_rate.responsible_role: accessibility research lead and participant advisory group
independent_task_completion_rate.recalculation_trigger: each closed paired-test round or protocol revision

assumptions: Channel equivalence requires user testing, not a file-count proxy.
multichannel_information_coverage.reason: Service-point inventory and multimodal accessibility audit are missing.
multichannel_information_coverage.numerator_definition: valid audited points where the same critical state or instruction is available through at least two participant-verified channels
multichannel_information_coverage.denominator_definition: all valid audited service and decision points in the agreed route or service inventory
multichannel_information_coverage.exclusions: points outside the agreed inventory, reported separately
multichannel_information_coverage.recalculation_trigger: interface, route, content, or channel change

assumptions: The same public task must be tested with AI enabled and disabled under equivalent reasonable accommodation.
ai_off_service_equivalence_gap.reason: No operational services or paired task-test results exist.
ai_off_service_equivalence_gap.numerator_definition: absolute difference between valid AI-on and AI-off completion rates for the same task protocol
ai_off_service_equivalence_gap.denominator_definition: valid paired tasks in each mode, with order, withdrawal, and technical-failure counts reported
ai_off_service_equivalence_gap.exclusions: unpaired observations are retained in the log but excluded from the paired estimate
ai_off_service_equivalence_gap.recalculation_trigger: AI model, fixed-information route, service procedure, or accommodation change

assumptions: Exit reasons must be participant-described or protocol-observed without inferring diagnosis.
forced_abandonment_rate.reason: No cleared participant task log or exit-reason record exists.
forced_abandonment_rate.numerator_definition: valid attempts ended after a recorded environmental, information, interaction, or service barrier
forced_abandonment_rate.denominator_definition: all valid task attempts, including completed and barrier-ended attempts
forced_abandonment_rate.exclusions: voluntary withdrawal unrelated to the task and technical failures are reported as separate denominator classes
forced_abandonment_rate.responsible_role: accessibility research lead and participant representatives
forced_abandonment_rate.recalculation_trigger: task-script, route, interface, or reasonable-accommodation change

assumptions: Handover must be timed and evaluated with informed participants in a controlled trial.
human_handover_success_rate.reason: No approved trial, operator rota, or response baseline is available.
human_handover_success_rate.numerator_definition: valid triggers acknowledged by an identified responsible person who provides the protocol-defined next action
human_handover_success_rate.denominator_definition: all valid handover triggers, including unanswered, misrouted, and late triggers
human_handover_success_rate.exclusions: test cancellations before a trigger and protocol-invalid triggers, with counts disclosed
human_handover_success_rate.responsible_role: service operator and accessibility test lead
human_handover_success_rate.recalculation_trigger: operator, rota, interface, escalation, or service-hours change

assumptions: The trigger and acknowledgement events must be defined before timing; no target threshold is asserted.
human_handover_response_time_seconds.reason: No approved exercise, timestamp log, or accountable operator baseline is available.
human_handover_response_time_seconds.numerator_definition: elapsed seconds from each valid trigger to first acknowledgement by the responsible human role
human_handover_response_time_seconds.denominator_definition: count of valid handover triggers; unanswered triggers are reported separately and never assigned an invented duration
human_handover_response_time_seconds.exclusions: protocol-invalid triggers only, with count and reason disclosed
human_handover_response_time_seconds.recalculation_trigger: operator, rota, interface, escalation, or service-hours change

assumptions: Exceedance criteria and recovery needs must be co-designed; file geometry alone cannot establish sensory load.
sensory_load_exceedance_point_count.reason: No cleared sound, light, crowding, or participatory sensory baseline exists.
sensory_load_exceedance_point_count.numerator_definition: distinct audited points confirmed under the agreed protocol as exceeding a defined sensory condition or lacking a usable recovery option
sensory_load_exceedance_point_count.denominator_definition: not applicable to a count; the audited route length and total audited points are reported as context
sensory_load_exceedance_point_count.exclusions: unvisited or protocol-incomplete points, listed separately
sensory_load_exceedance_point_count.responsible_role: environmental assessment lead and participant advisory group
sensory_load_exceedance_point_count.recalculation_trigger: route, event programme, lighting, sound, crowd management, or recovery-space change

assumptions: Role-group coverage does not measure personal ability, diagnosis, identity, or representativeness by headcount.
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.reason: No approved ethics protocol, recruitment record, or participant-role structure exists.
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.numerator_definition: protocol-required participant, caregiver where relevant, operator, maintainer, and professional role groups with at least one voluntary contribution recorded
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.denominator_definition: all role groups required by the approved co-design protocol for that task
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.exclusions: observers without a recorded contribution; withdrawals remain reported
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.responsible_role: co-design lead, ethics reviewer, and participant representatives
co_design_role_coverage_ratio.recalculation_trigger: task scope, participant group, operating model, or protocol change
